data.vehicle_control: Enable vehicle control (experimental and at your own risk)
data.zone: Limit vehicle control to the following zones

error.2fa_unverified: Enrolling a new vehicle key needs two-factor authentication confirmed. Turn on 2FA in your Rivian account if needed, re-authenticate the Rivian integration from Settings > Devices & services, then try again.
error.phone_limit: Insufficient phone slots available to enable vehicle control

send_destination.name: Send destination
send_destination.description: Sends a navigation destination to the vehicle. Rivian looks up the text as a place search.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Rivian vehicle to send the destination to.

location.name: Location
location.description: A place name, a business name with its address, a street address, or a Google Maps share link. A person's name will not resolve; send their address instead.

wake.name: Wake vehicle
wake.description: Wake the vehicle first if it is asleep.

replace.name: Replace current trip
replace.description: End the vehicle's current trip first, so the destination doesn't get added as an extra stop.

end_trip.name: End trip
end_trip.description: Clears the vehicle's active trip, like the End Trip button on the display.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Rivian vehicle whose trip to end.

plan_trip.name: Plan trip
plan_trip.description: Plans a trip from the vehicle's current position with Rivian's trip planner and returns the drive time, charging stops and arrival charge. Nothing is sent to the vehicle.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Rivian vehicle to plan for.

location.name: Destination
location.description: A place name, address, Google Maps share link, or latitude,longitude.

departure_time.name: Departure time
departure_time.description: When the trip starts. Defaults to now.
